checkpoints.description: Task 'CC-029' completed successfully.
[1/1] Canvas fit and click-to-move: keep the 760:540 bitmap ratio, map pointer input through the drawn content box, guard with tests and harness selftest checks, record before/after evidence

impact_assessment.why: At 1440x900 and 1920x1080 the canvas element was 100% tall while the bitmap was letterboxed, leaving 116-140px black bands and a smaller map; pointer mapping used the full element rect, so off-center clicks decoded one or more tiles off and band clicks moved the hero
impact_assessment.benefits: The frame hugs the map at every viewport, tiles grow 54px -> 66px at 1920x1080, click-to-move lands on the visible tile and band clicks are inert
impact_assessment.risks: contract: _getTileAtPointer returns null in a letterbox band; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save or RNG change; UI: style.css and engine.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Three selftest checks failed first (gap 116, 5,17 -> 5,18, band decode); CSS/mapping source contract test; inspector at three viewports; full unit and aikit gates

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Combat feel: stack simultaneous damage numbers at the same tile so twin hits are legible, prove with a selftest check and a real two-goblin turn

impact_assessment.why: Two enemies striking in one enemy phase spawn damage floats at the same x/y with identical velocity and life, so the canvas shows one number while the player loses two hits; the combat log names both but the map does not
impact_assessment.benefits: Twin hits read as two numbers whose sum equals the HP lost, while single hits, loot and heals keep their position
impact_assessment.risks: contract: addFloatingText offsets concurrent floats by 18px; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save or RNG change; UI: renderer.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Selftest check failed first (two floats y=1021, distinct 1, damage 10); same-state before/after screenshots at turn 3 with a real two-goblin phase; inspector at three viewports; full gates
